name: academic-writing-assistant
description: A fidelity-first academic writing Skill for Chinese and English research papers.

interface.shortDescription: Fidelity-first academic writing support for researchers.
interface.longDescription: A reusable Skill for researchers writing in Chinese and English. It improves manuscripts without moving the boundary between what the evidence supports and what it does not: every edit is classified as surface, structure, or claim, and claim-level changes are never applied silently. Covers polishing, translation, section drafting, journal response letters and conference rebuttals, submission materials, LaTeX-aware editing, and whole-draft consistency checking.
defaultPrompt: Polish this paragraph for a computer vision paper.
Translate this Chinese academic paragraph into English.
Draft a rebuttal to this reviewer comment.
Check this draft for terminology and claim consistency.
